City Council  Wednesday, December 15, 2021
  The safety and well-being of employees and the public remains the City's top priority. The

 The City Council is making every effort to follow the spirit and intent of the Brown Act and

 transparency and public access.

 If you require oral Spanish translation, please contact the City Clerk’s Office at (661) 267-

 “Your courtesy is requested to help our meetings run smoothly. If you’ll be kind enough to
 follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:

  Please refrain from public displays or outbursts, such as unsolicited applause,
  comments, cheering, foul language or obscenities.
  Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council
  to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be asked to leave the
  meeting.

SUBJECT:  DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE ACTION REGARDING MAYOR PRO
  TEM APPOINTMENT

ISSUE
Discussion and possible action regarding the Mayor Pro Tem Appointment.

RECOMMENDATION
Provide direction.

BACKGROUND
Resolution No. CC 2017-008 provides for the appointment of the Mayor Pro Tem by a
majority vote of the City Council. The Mayor Pro Tem serves at the pleasure of the City
Council. The councilmember appointed as Mayor Pro Tem also serves as the Vice Chair
of the Successor Agency, the Housing Authority, the Palmdale Airport Authority, the
Palmdale Finance Authority, and the Palmdale Civic Authority and Chair Pro Tem of the
Industrial Development Authority.

DISCUSSION
At the December 15, 2020 City Council meeting, Laura Bettencourt was appointed
as the Mayor Pro Tem and is currently serving in the position.

FISCAL IMPACT
There is no fiscal impact associated with this item.
